Have a great week,

notes.title: Anniversary Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have been working on improving the performance of the game and fixing some minor bugs. Now it is ready and we are excited to be able to release this patch on our anniversary! You can find more detailed info below.

v1.3.0 Patch Notes


 Decreased RAM, VRAM, and disk usage significantly without sacrificing quality.
 Improved the overall sound and music quality.
 Added new sound effects and changed some of them as well.
 Started using VSync instead of locking the frame rate to 60 fps. Currently it is not in options. However, we are keeping a close eye on it. If there is a problem please report.
 Balanced timed puzzles of chapter 1 and 2.
 Improved puzzle readability on some puzzle rooms.
 Fixed an issue where in some cases stones fly where stuck between a rock and a hard place.
 Fixed a rare issue while pulling objects in magical form, you could also move physical body on some slopes.
 Fixed an uncommon issue on chapter 2 room 14 that makes the puzzle unsolvable.
 Fixed some minor environment issues.
 Fixed an issue where after the end game cinematic, menu buttons didn't work with keyboard and controllers.
 Fixed menu navigation with keyboard and controllers.

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 is available now!
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes:

 Fixed a rare issue where the game crashes upon launch.
 Fixed an issue where the subtitles won't show correctly for the players using localized Windows versions.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 is available now!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We added support for Dualshock controllers and generic controllers for both OSX and Windows.

We were working on adding more controller support for a while now and it is finally here. We are sorry we couldn't bring the update to you sooner.

Now you can use your various controllers to play Macrotis! Don't hesitate to let us know if you have any issues.

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 is available now!
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes:

Fixed an issue where switching between applications during credits freezes the game.
Fixed a rare issue where you can place more than 3 barricades.
 After your feedback we changed some of the dialogues to not trigger after restarting from a checkpoint. We will keep monitoring your feedback for these changes.
 Fixed some visual glitches.

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 is available now!
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes:


 Fixed a rare issue where you could control the physical body while in magical form.

 Fixed an issue where after closing the magical form you couldn't interact with objects.

 Fixed an issue where the animation for magical form's closing didn't work when you killed your physical form while in the magical form.

 Now when you accidentally press the magical form button more than once, it doesn't close immediately.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 is available now!
notes.notes:
Here are the patch notes:

Fixed an issue where you can't get the achievement "Think before you act" if you completed the chapter using your magical form.

Fixed an issue where you can get out of the playzone through some of the walls.

Music playlist improvements. Also, fixed an issue where the music for the end of Chapter 4 doesn't loop.

Fixed an issue where the credits end sooner than expected.

Fixed a camera issue in the last puzzle of chapter 2 where you can get out of camera's viewport.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32720798/62ca28b78b05487034b42fc6d9ec550f1f32ea31.png

Macrotis: A Mother's Journey will be officially released on February 8!

Thank you all for joining our journey and for your patience. We are almost there!

notes.title: Postponing the Release of Macrotis
notes.notes:
We decided to postpone the release of Macrotis: A Mother's Journey because we want to give you the best game that we possibly can.

We are fixing bugs, working on sounds, making transitional videos between chapters, and polishing the environment to make it look even more beautiful at the moment. The end product will look, sound, and feel amazing!

Your support means a lot to us and we hope that you will continue to show us your love while we put the finishing touches on Macrotis.

Hopefully, you will be playing our game in early 2019!
